name: discord-clone-e2ee
description: Discord Clone com Chamadas de Voz, Vídeo, Compartilhamento de Tela e E2EE

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.app: concurrently -n "SERVER,DESKTOP" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run electron:dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
